purpose: Local source-grounded extraction experiment; not production facts or approved nanopublications

policy.source_authority: The exported original chunk text, not summaries, candidates or previous model outputs
policy.scope: Extract a bounded representative set of own numerical results and the context that binds them; record inspected scope honestly
policy.evidence: Every object, group, membership, assertion, result and condition must carry short verbatim supporting quotations
policy.ambiguity: Retain uncertainty and alternative assignments; do not invent missing units, reference electrodes, uncertainty definitions, or normalization
policy.separation: Keep reported results, simulations, fitted parameters and quoted work distinct; do not combine maxima at different operating points
policy.state: All agent output is proposed. Passing mechanical checks is not scientific validation or human approval.
policy.supplements: A mention of supporting information is not proof that its contents were accessed
policy.coverage: Only list chunks actually inspected; available source text is not equivalent to inspected source text
policy.revision: Write a new round directory; never overwrite earlier extraction or review artifacts

top_level.producer: string describing the actual producing agent; do not invent a model identifier

anchor.quote: nonempty exact substring of the original chunk; preserve LaTeX/HTML and punctuation
anchor.occurrence: optional zero-based integer, REQUIRED if the same quote occurs more than once in this chunk

group.label: string
group.summary: brief navigational interpretation, not replacement evidence

result.context_id: existing group/object ID or null when unresolved
result.measurand: specific quantity name, not a generic performance label
result.reported_value: string containing the literal numerical value or bound appearing in its evidence; no calculations or normalization
result.normalization_basis: string or null, e.g. geometric electrode area vs catalyst mass vs active-metal mass
result.uncertainty: string or null; preserve the reported notation and do not infer its statistical meaning

conditions.name: string
conditions.value: reported string appearing in this condition's evidence

requested_minimum_per_paper.groups: At least one group linking description/context and results where justified
requested_minimum_per_paper.results: About 4-8 representative numerical results when available; fewer is valid if evidence is insufficient
requested_minimum_per_paper.audit_targets: Report any tempting but unjustified linkage, mismatched condition, alternative denominator, or boundary between simulation and experiment
